title: Launch day diary + quick fixes
content:
Daily quick log (scratchpad) — launch window runbook + small post-launch edits

Tuesday 2026-03-11 — high level
- Morning: final PRD pass (section: rollout + fallback policies) — trimmed duplicate text, clarified canary traffic rules.
- Midday: sync with infra (Ethan) on capacity bump for Dedicated trial customers. Confirmed extra pool scaled at 09:30PT.
- Afternoon: triage incoming customer questions from beta list, flagged 3 items to product ops.

Immediate TODOs (short, actionable)
- [ ] Add explicit note in PRD about metric used for automatic fallback: p50 latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes => fallback to smaller model. (PRD line ~275)
- [ ] Update rollout checklist: add step "verify model version pin is active in private control plane" and owner for that step.
- [ ] Draft the email for enterprise customers re: planned Dedicated maintenance window (Priya to review).
- [ ] Create small smoke test for embeddings endpoint that runs post-deploy (script name: smoke/embeddings-smoke.sh).

PRD edits (rough diff notes)
- Section: Rollout strategy — simplified language, removed internal-only ops detail. Left a pointer to infra runbook.
- Section: Rate limiting & quotas — added table for default quotas during canary (50 rps / 5s burst). Need infra to verify this is feasible.
- Section: Observability — add example trace alias for token-level latency (example: token_latency.sample).

Stakeholder follow-ups (who/what/how)
- Ethan Chen (infra): confirm autoscaler policy change landed. Followed up via Slack TS12345. Waiting for green from SRE.
- Priya Rao (GTM): draft launch email + customer FAQ. Action: Priya will own customer-facing messaging.
- Marcus (legal): quick check on term "data residency" phrasing in private deployment blurb. Sent doc, asked for reply by EOD.
- Eng: assign tiny bug to serving-runtime team — tokenization mismatch on long inputs (found in beta run). Link: RED-2345.

Post-launch small fixes (ideation)
- Add a tiny banner in Console when a model is in fallback state ("Serving on fallback model due to latency"). Should be purely informational, no CTA.
- Auto-link failed requests in logs to the nearest rollback-enabled snapshot to speed debugging.
- Improve error message for "quota exceeded" to include a suggested next step and a link to upgrade path.

Open questions / risks
- If canary detects regressions on quality (not perf), do we have automated rollback or only manual? Current plan: manual rollback. Consider automating for simple heuristics.
- Spike traffic pattern unknown for enterprise onboarding — do we throttle each seat or apply org-level quotas? Need GTM input.
- Observability retention: default 7 days for detailed token traces — should enterprise get 30 days? Cost impact unclear.

Meeting notes snippets (bullet form)
- 10:00 sync w/infra: autoscaler needs 2 more minutes on cool-down to avoid oscillation. (Ethan)
- 11:15 doc review: Priya suggests adding 2 FAQs about private deployments and audit logs.
- 14:00 beta debrief: 2 customers saw higher embedding variance. Action: run eval set A vs B on quantized models.

Quick timeline for next 48h
- Wed morning: lock PRD and send to Marcus for final legal.
- Wed noon: merge canary config (ops-owned) and schedule 10% traffic shift at 13:00PT.
- Wed afternoon: run smoke tests and confirm logs/tracing.
- Thu: retrospective and postmortem template ready if anything goes sideways.

Notes to self (short)
- Keep the PRD intro <200 words — execs skim.
- Use plain English for fallback rules; save operator detail for runbook.
- When you write the email subject: "Redwood: Hosted API launch — Dedicated + Private availability"

Fragments / ideas to expand later
- Short one-pager: "When to use Dedicated vs Private" (diagram + 3 bullets each).
- Mini-runbook: "What to do if canary fails" (3-step: rollback, notify, root-cause triage).

End-of-day: capture small wins
- PRD cleared for legal review.
- Confirmed autoscaler minor change.
- Identified 1 high-priority bug (RED-2345) and assigned to serving-runtime.

-- Sofia
